description: Official authoring voice direction requested by Lily on 2026-11-11. Descriptions standardize casting. Cal and Stacy additionally have selected voice references. Other timbres await listening approval.
recording_direction: Clean close-microphone speech at a conversational level. Preserve authored words, pauses and speaker identity. Produce dry voice audio for later in-game acoustics.

profiles.voice_description: A mature, warm lower-middle speaking register with a firm clear tone and precise consonants.
profiles.delivery_direction: Measured teacherly phrasing. Corrections arrive as care. Anger sharpens the grammar and articulation without raising the volume.

profiles.voice_description: A steady middle-low register, softly textured with audible fatigue and reliable breath support.
profiles.delivery_direction: Practical and clipped under pressure. Give fuller phrases and a little warmth once danger has passed. Fatigue never makes the words unintelligible.

profiles.voice_description: A mature clear middle register with a cool, focused tone, controlled breath and very precise consonants.
profiles.delivery_direction: Accumulate corrections carefully, with small thinking pauses. Official precision can fray into an intimate, less polished confession.

profiles.voice_description: A warm resonant middle register with a gently textured tone and comfortable, unhurried breath.
profiles.delivery_direction: Practical hospitality and steady phrasing. A firm refusal may arrive inside a generous offer. Let a family judgment land quietly.

profiles.voice_description: A bright flexible middle register with forward resonance and quick, clean articulation.
profiles.delivery_direction: Rhythmic associative bursts with abrupt changes of direction. Leave a beat around a technical dare. Sincerity arrives directly without a prepared flourish.

profiles.voice_description: A low, soft, lightly textured register with rounded resonance and patient breath.
profiles.delivery_direction: Deliberate, tactile descriptions. Let a pause carry an unspoken qualification. Tenderness is ordinary and restrained.

profiles.voice_description: A grounded lower-middle register, slightly coarse at the edges, with sturdy resonance and exact consonants.
profiles.delivery_direction: Short diagnoses and measured mechanical verbs. Quiet professional certainty. Emotional weight belongs to the part he chooses to preserve.

profiles.voice_description: A clear resonant middle register with trained breath, flexible dynamics and an easy supported tone.
profiles.delivery_direction: Deliberate entrances and expressive timing. Let a small private afterthought escape after a polished public phrase. Preserve the difference between speaking and singing.

profiles.voice_description: A light, narrow middle register with a little breath in the tone and careful diction.
profiles.delivery_direction: Nested qualifications and brief permission-seeking hesitations. A rare decisive verb becomes unexpectedly direct and firm.

profiles.voice_description: A bright forward middle register with compact energy, fast articulation and short well-supported breaths.
profiles.delivery_direction: Kinetic and directional. Move quickly through preamble, keep destinations clear, and allow a restless interruption. Slow down when choosing to stay.

profiles.voice_description: A smooth restrained lower-middle register with even volume, controlled breath and precise articulation.
profiles.delivery_direction: Measured conservation-report phrasing. Alarm first appears as a tiny tightening of diction. Personal warmth is small and specific.

profiles.voice_description: A light middle register with smooth resonance, cautious starts and a gentle rising inflection.
profiles.delivery_direction: Mirror the other speaker's vocabulary while searching for permission to remain. Keep this voice distinct from Guest B.

profiles.voice_description: A lower, drier middle register with a little air in the tone and quicker phrase endings.
profiles.delivery_direction: Answer Guest A with courteous certainty, then expose a small incompatible preference. Keep this voice distinct from Guest A.

profiles.voice_description: A focused lower-middle register with clear projection, controlled breath and firm falling cadences.
profiles.delivery_direction: Organized causal chains and architectural overview. Decisions sound already built. Uncertainty briefly interrupts the otherwise exact structure.

profiles.voice_description: An older man from Queens, New York, with a low dry slightly grainy voice. Quiet conversational delivery close to the microphone.
profiles.delivery_direction: Deliberate pauses, restrained unease and a trace of stubborn certainty. Patient technical clauses give way to a plain sentence when the carrier falls silent.

reference.text: Listen. That's last Tuesday. Clear as glass. I didn't record it. The set is receiving it.
reference.design_prompt: An older man from Queens, New York, with a low dry slightly grainy voice. Quiet conversational delivery close to the microphone. Deliberate pauses, restrained unease and a trace of stubborn certainty. Natural speech, no announcer performance, no music.

profiles.voice_description: A warm open middle register with a bright edge, slight grain and flexible conversational inflection.
profiles.delivery_direction: Name color and light before explaining causes. Let apparent spontaneity briefly check its own composition. Candid admissions still care who is listening.

profiles.voice_description: An androgynous middle register with a dry, steady tone, clear diction and economical breath.
profiles.delivery_direction: Spare observations and considered ethical qualifiers. Give space to what is deliberately left outside the frame. Avoid a theatrical investigator voice.

profiles.voice_description: A soft lower-middle register with a faint roughness, intimate resonance and hesitant phrase starts.
profiles.delivery_direction: Allow revisions and alternative clauses to interrupt an unfinished thought. Rare finality should have unusual weight and a clean ending.

profiles.voice_description: A rounded lower-middle register with polished articulation, controlled breath and unhurried authority.
profiles.delivery_direction: Exact attributions and sovereign declarations. Courtesy can become sharply territorial. Keep the surface composed even when certainty is threatened.

profiles.voice_description: A middle aged woman who runs a small Queens bar in 1929, warm lower register with a lightly husky edge and a natural New York accent.
profiles.delivery_direction: Brisk conversational timing, dry amusement and affectionate authority. Play a joke straight and give its turn room to land.

reference.text: It's tea. The teapot's legal. The cup's legal. The saucer has never been to court.
reference.design_prompt: A middle aged woman who runs a small Queens bar in 1929, warm lower register with a lightly husky edge and a natural New York accent. Brisk conversational timing, dry amusement, affectionate authority. Play the joke straight with a small pause before the final sentence. Clean close microphone speech, no music.

profiles.voice_description: A clear, warm, velvety middle register with a singer's supported breath, flexible phrasing and intimate resonance.
profiles.delivery_direction: An observant, lively conversational wit. Keep private vulnerability close and direct. Spoken lines retain their own rhythm apart from her sung performances.

profiles.voice_description: A clear, quiet middle register with a lightly breathy edge and restrained tension.
profiles.delivery_direction: A caller trying to describe what she can actually hear. Thoughtful starts and controlled urgency, leaving enough space to listen.

profiles.voice_description: Lily's own recorded speaking voice, preserving her natural register, accent, texture and breath.
profiles.delivery_direction: Use the delivery in Lily's supplied reference and her direction for the line. Her recorded performance establishes the voice.

profiles.voice_description: A compact, dry mechanical speaking tone with precise articulation, a mild inquisitive lift and room for affectionate understatement.
profiles.delivery_direction: Current articulate exchanges are written. Preserve babble, emotes and the authored progression toward speech. Record spoken English only when the scene explicitly authorizes it.

profiles.voice_description: The player host has no independent authored speaking performance.
profiles.delivery_direction: Keep player choice labels and silent actions unvoiced unless an authored scene explicitly assigns a speaker.

profiles.voice_description: Two distinct recurring voices, Guest A and Guest B, with separate voice identities.
profiles.delivery_direction: Record marked turns with the corresponding guest profile. The pair may disagree and never delivers omniscient exposition as a chorus.
